scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @taskflow/web" "npm run dev -w @taskflow/api"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @taskflow/web && npm run lint -w @taskflow/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @taskflow/web && npm run typecheck -w @taskflow/api
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build -w @taskflow/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @taskflow/api
